## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Every artifact class listed in docs/guides/state-artifacts.md, plus...

The system SHALL ensure that every artifact class listed in docs/guides/state-artifacts.md, plus effects.jsonl and phase-progress journals, has exactly one fork policy entry in the registry, enforced by a test that diffs the inventory against the registry.

#### Scenario: Every artifact class listed in docs/guides/state-artifacts.md, plus...

WHEN `add-fork-policy-registry-for-durable-artifacts` is implemented
THEN Every artifact class listed in docs/guides/state-artifacts.md, plus effects.jsonl and phase-progress journals, has exactly one fork policy entry in the registry, enforced by a test that diffs the inventory against the registry.

### Requirement: Owning readers of latest-policy artifacts (checkpoint.json, supervisor cycle...

The system SHALL ensure that owning readers of latest-policy artifacts (checkpoint.json, supervisor cycle ledger, generated docs/decisions/) resolve the main-line value rather than a forked copy, covered by a unit test per policy.

#### Scenario: Owning readers of latest-policy artifacts (checkpoint.json, supervisor cycle...

WHEN `add-fork-policy-registry-for-durable-artifacts` is implemented
THEN Owning readers of latest-policy artifacts (checkpoint.json, supervisor cycle ledger, generated docs/decisions/) resolve the main-line value rather than a forked copy, covered by a unit test per policy.

### Requirement: The registry is deterministic and does not change the supervisor cycle...

The system SHALL ensure that the registry is deterministic and does not change the supervisor cycle fingerprint.

#### Scenario: The registry is deterministic and does not change the supervisor cycle...

WHEN `add-fork-policy-registry-for-durable-artifacts` is implemented
THEN The registry is deterministic and does not change the supervisor cycle fingerprint.
